_comment: Four agent journeys against aragora AS IT EXISTS TODAY. These are the
baseline: what an agent currently pays to answer one operational question.
Every command here is read-only. Do not add a mutating command to this file.
Journeys 1 and 4 are the two that carry hard budgets, because they are the
two an agent pays on EVERY session and every tick respectively. Journeys 2
PR 9924 is used as the live subject. It was READY at capture time; if it has
since merged, re-point these at any open ready PR -- the shape of the
measurement does not depend on which PR it is.

cold_orientation.question: I just woke up in this repo with no context. What is true right now, and what is the single safest next action I can take?

calls.label: what work is assigned to me

quiet_recheck.question: Nothing has obviously happened. Has anything meaningful changed since I last looked?

resumption.question: I was working on PR 9924 before I was interrupted. Did it land? If not, what is blocking it, and is the blocker mine to fix?

calls.label: commit statuses (join step 2)
calls.cmd: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/$(gh pr view 9924 --json headRefOid --jq .headRefOid)/statuses --jq '.[] | "\(.context)\t\(.state)\t\(.created_at)"'

calls.label: did it actually land on main?
calls.cmd: git log origin/main --oneline -50 | grep -i 9924 || echo 'not found in last 50 commits'

capsule_cold.question: [AFTER] I just woke up with no context. What is true, and what is the safest next action?

capsule_quiet.question: [AFTER] Has anything meaningful changed since my last cursor?

calls.label: delta against held cursor
calls.cmd: python3 scripts/agent_surface/situation.py --since $(python3 scripts/agent_surface/situation.py --json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["cursor"])')

high_risk_settle.question: Is PR 9924 genuinely settled and safe to merge, or would merging it violate the gate?

calls.label: settlement status tool
calls.cmd: python3 scripts/settle_status.py 9924 2>&1 || echo 'settle_status.py did not resolve'

calls.label: human-settlement status (the authoritative one)
calls.cmd: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/$(gh pr view 9924 --json headRefOid --jq .headRefOid)/statuses --jq '[.[] | select(.context | test("settlement"))] | .[0] // "NO SETTLEMENT STATUS"'

calls.label: required checks present?
calls.cmd: gh pr checks 9924 --json name,state,bucket 2>/dev/null | head -c 4000 || gh pr checks 9924 | head -40
